details:
When an user ("User 1") gets kicked by an instance moderator while a majority vote kick is ongoing, a pending vote kick does not get cancelled and the vote kick may succeed after the instance kick, resulting in the user receiving group audit log entries for both instance moderation kick & majority vote kick ejection.

To annotate the attached picture:

1. An user in the instance started a vote kick against User 1 at 12:08 (AM). (client logs: 00:08:46 (UTC))

2. An user in the instance started a vote kick against User 2 at 12:09 (AM). (client logs: 00:09:05 (UTC))

3. User 1 got kicked at 12:09 (AM) by an instance moderator (Moderator 1). (client logs: 00:10:13 (UTC))

4. Because User 1 got kicked by Moderator 1 or an additional vote was cast (step 3), the vote kick against User 2 reached majority and User 2 was ejected immediately after by majority vote as a result three seconds later at 12:09 AM (client logs: 00:10:16 (UTC)), further reducing the majority required to vote kick User 1. A notification was displayed in client about a majority vote kick succeeding against User 2.

5. User 3 gets kicked by Moderator 1 at 12:11 AM (client logs: 00:11:08 (UTC)), further reducing the majority required to vote kick User 1.

6. User 1 was audit logged to have been kicked a second time by majority vote kick at 12:11 (AM), two minutes after being instance kicked by Moderator 1, and approximately immediately after User 3 was kicked. Users in the instance did not receive a notification about this vote kick against User 1 succeeding, because User 1 was not in the instance anymore.

Expected result: Because Moderator 1 kicked User 1 making them unable to join the instance for 1 hour and the majority quorum was forced by moderation actions anyway, the ongoing vote to kick User 1 becomes pointless. The ongoing vote kick against User 1 in the same instance should've been cancelled or the audit log about majority vote succeeding against User 1 should've been suppressed, just like the in-client notification about User 1 being ejected by majority was suppressed because the user wasn't in the instance anymore.

Actual result: User 1 received both Moderator 1 instance moderation kick & majority vote kick from all instance users in the audit logs.

Additional info: The group affected was [Chill ＜＞＜](https://vrc.group/CHILLF.1917) (`grp_52bf6a2e-4bb9-4e20-84ef-206b21218970`) on 2026-09-27 at 12:08 AM. This was the only instance the group was hosting at the time, so it's not possible for User 1 to have been vote kicked in another one of the instances. Pseudonymized client logs have been attached in two variants: full, and simplified with the noise filtered out.

The instance was `wrld_ebfa74e9-486b-4b1b-9f86-76ed982fc454:11596~group(grp_52bf6a2e-4bb9-4e20-84ef-206b21218970)~groupAccessType(public)~region(use)`.
title: A same user in a group was audit logged to have been both the instance moderation kicked and majority vote kicked within minutes of each other
